files.purpose: Placeholder README explaining that Pandoc defaults files should live in this directory.
Pandoc defaults preset for markdown-to-markdown note ingestion that runs the NDJSON emission filter.
Pandoc defaults preset for markdown labeling that applies the metadata fill filter.
Usage notes for running Lua and Python panflute filters.
No-op placeholder filter for NDJSON-oriented pipelines; currently returns the document unchanged.
Stops conversion early if the configured Pandoc output file already exists.
Serializes the document to markdown, copies it to the X clipboard via xclip, prints a status line, and exits.
Keeps only sections whose heading levels match the `heading_filter` metadata list.
Maps symbol-prefixed paragraphs to styled Div blocks, optionally limited by `components` metadata, and logs malformed paragraphs.
Filters out links to unchanged local files by diffing the current tree against a submission commit.
Wraps paragraphs that start with a non-alphabetic character in square brackets, despite the filename suggesting removal.
Intended to recursively remove raw HTML comments from blocks and inlines.
Removes strong text and attempts to remove emphasis markup.
Removes all image elements from the document.
Replaces links with their visible text only.
Unwraps spans and returns their inline content directly.
Converts code blocks into paragraphs, bullet lists, or nothing based on `codeblock-mode` metadata.
Captures the first level-1 header, removes it from the body, and stores a sanitized version in metadata as `title`.
Promotes any paragraph containing strong text into a level-1 heading.
Restyles Sidebar headers and turns ordered lists into labeled image-outline blocks for layout-oriented output.
Prepends a generated H1 from the first available metadata field among `header`, `title`, `chapter`, or `image`.
Splits a document into section JSON files at a configured header level and annotates each chunk with provenance metadata.
Adds fixed-height styling to images and flex-row styling to Divs with the `image_row` class.
Transforms raw inline comment-like content into comment-start/comment-end spans with author and timestamp attributes.
Prefixes dotted header segments with human-readable labels like Section, Chapter, and Feature.
Normalizes `file://` link targets into plain filesystem paths.
Replaces images with empty sources by strong text prompting that an image is needed.
Intended to inject a thumbnail image from metadata into the first paragraph or prepend it as its own paragraph.
Replaces a paragraph marked with a `content_to_expand` link by loading and inlining markdown from the other links in that paragraph.
Counts words, writes document metadata into Redis under a derived key, prints the key, and exits.
Copies Pandoc input and output file paths into metadata fields such as `inputfile`, `source`, and `outputfile`.
Captures the first level-1 header as `header` metadata and removes it from the body.
Prints a readable representation of all metadata fields to stderr for debugging.
Fills missing `uid` and `slug` metadata and normalizes provenance-related metadata fields to strings.
Adds a human-readable `created` date to metadata if one is not already present.
Prints the Pandoc output path or file URL and can optionally copy that path to the clipboard.
Appends raw changed git diff lines to the rendered document when the current input file has uncommitted changes.
Terminates conversion immediately without producing normal output.
Counts body words, prints the result using metadata or output filename as the label, and exits.
Panflute filter that splits content whenever a block matches `split-pattern` metadata and emits the resulting sections as NDJSON documents.
Package marker for standalone panflute filters in this toolchain.
Standalone panflute filter that wraps symbol-prefixed paragraphs in custom-style Divs and expands `content_to_expand` links from local files.
Component-aware panflute formatter that surrounds symbol-tagged paragraphs with review or layout wrapper Divs.
Splits notes by header, fills metadata, guards against duplicate outputs, and shells out to Pandoc to write chunked markdown files.
Reads layout annotations from metadata, paints them onto page images with Pillow, and assembles the result into a PDF.
Front-matter template for image captions with page, position, description, word count, and status fields.
Template for chapter notes with chapter number, title, and status front matter.
Simple heading-based template for collecting comments associated with a named item.
Template for storing AI completion metadata such as instruction, prompt, model, and max token count.
Template for generated content with title and status front matter.
Generic document template with identifying metadata, sequence, status, and header slots.
Flexible edit-focused template that conditionally emits common metadata fields before the body.
Minimal instructions template with a `parents` metadata list.
Template for LinkedIn content with name, platform, heading, caption, and body content fields.
Passage note template with uid, slug, status, tags, and type metadata.
ConTeXt template for rendering a styled A4 resume with custom layout, colors, section styling, and helper macros.
Template for story notes with title, note reference, and manual-creation status metadata.

findings.issue: The filter path is hard-coded to `/home/jeremy/Tools/...`, which does not match this checkout under `/home/jeremy/Workbench`.
findings.impact: This defaults preset will fail unless the same filters also exist at the older absolute path.

findings.issue: The filter path is hard-coded to `/home/jeremy/Tools/...` rather than the current repository location.
findings.impact: Running this defaults file from the current workspace is likely to miss the intended filter.

findings.issue: The filter treats `link_inline.target` like an array (`target[1]`, `target[2]`) even though Pandoc Lua links expose the target as a string.
findings.impact: Linked-content expansion is likely to resolve the wrong path or fail outright.

findings.issue: The top-level handler is named `Doc` instead of the standard Pandoc Lua document handler `Pandoc`.
findings.impact: The filter may never run, leaving thumbnail injection inactive.

findings.issue: Comment stripping uses `gsub("", "", 1)` instead of a comment-matching pattern.
findings.impact: HTML comments are unlikely to be removed as intended.

findings.issue: The emphasis handler is misspelled as `Empahsis`.
findings.impact: Emphasis markup will not be stripped, so the filter only affects strong text.

findings.issue: The default layout companion file `layout_divs.yaml` is referenced but not present in this directory.
findings.impact: The filter falls back to an empty layout map unless `PANDOC_LAYOUT_FILE` is supplied.
